summary: Tested 4 production bug fixes for gymaxisai.com: (1) Password reset URL now uses brand-aware domains, (2) Marketing entitlement self-heals for paid platform plans, (3) Gym Health Score shows 'pts' suffix and 'How to improve' tips, (4) CRM branding fix for Pulse accounts. Fixed a runtime error in CRMApp.js where platformUser was used before initialization.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error 'Cannot access platformUser before initialization' - FIXED by changing platformUser?.account_type to mainAuth?.user?.account_type

action_items: Verify CRM branding fix works in production after deployment
critical_code_review_comments: CRMApp.js line 469: platformUser was used before it was defined at line 733 - fixed by using mainAuth?.user?.account_type instead

success_rate.frontend: 90% (CRM runtime error fixed, other features verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset URL uses preview URL in preview environment (expected - FRONTEND_URL fallback). In production, brand-aware URLs (gymaxisai.com/pulsefitness.ai) will be used. CRM branding fix applied - changed platformUser to mainAuth?.user in isPulseAccount check.
